youtube_description:
This is our way of introducing you to Astronomy, the study of the stars. In this series we learn about Astronomy, its history, and its significance today. Let us study the stars together.
Catch up with the series:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5aWrGIrvhHI&list=PLL_goa1V630JSsGF0CQZP5_zubxS5oFJW
Website:
https://www.quanted.webador.com/
Visit our "What If?" workshop and register for free today:
https://quanted.webador.com/events
SOCIALS:
-Discord:https://discord.gg/n3zRQutW7m
-Twitter:https://twitter.com/QuantEDNovi
-Twitch:https://www.twitch.tv/quanted_novi
-Facebook:https://www.facebook.com/quantedinternational
About Us:
We are a group of educators with a goal of spreading STEM and the applications of STEM around the world. We will spread STEM through interactive workshops and even do research projects regarding wildlife, engineering, mathematics, art, etc. We hope you join us through our journey!
